ev.q: more medicine is not always better medicine

1.why: A段。invariably improves ↔ 作者明确说 more medicine is not always better medicine，而且 Some of this care does patients harm。题干的 invariably（总是）与原文直接矛盾，所以是 NO。

ev.q: in most cases for tumours that would never have troubled them

2.why: B段末句。Most of … would not have been harmed ↔ in most cases for tumours that would never have troubled them；lost their thyroid gland ↔ had their thyroid removed。

ev.q: Doctors may fear being sued for missing a disease

3.why: C段把怕被起诉列为几个原因之一，但作者没有说哪个原因最重要。认为“决定性因素”是付费制度的是 Okoye，不是作者本人，而且她说的也不是诉讼。所以作者的观点无从判断。

ev.q: Attempts to address the problem have so far achieved less than their supporters hoped.

4.why: D段首句。more effective than its supporters expected ↔ achieved less than their supporters hoped，方向完全相反。

ev.q: Under such uncertainty, some degree of overtreatment may be the price of catching the cases that matter.

5.why: E段。A certain amount of unnecessary treatment ↔ some degree of overtreatment；may be impossible to avoid ↔ may be the price of catching the cases that matter。

ev.q: Overdiagnosis is not the same as a false positive, in which a test wrongly suggests that a disease is present

6.why: B段。a contrast between two different problems ↔ Overdiagnosis is not the same as a false positive。

ev.q: The idea has since been taken up in more than twenty countries.

7.why: D段。an initiative being adopted beyond its country of origin ↔ Choosing Wisely … launched in the United States … taken up in more than twenty countries。

ev.q: there is no reliable way of telling, at the time of diagnosis, which abnormalities will grow and which will remain harmless

8.why: E段。hard to predict which cases need treatment ↔ no reliable way of telling … which abnormalities will grow and which will remain harmless。B段说的是已经确诊、但其实无害的病例，不是“为什么难以预测”。

ev.q: when the level of blood pressure or blood sugar regarded as abnormal is lowered, millions of people become patients overnight

9.why: C段。the boundaries of an illness being redrawn ↔ The definitions of some conditions have also been widened … the level … regarded as abnormal is lowered。

ev.q: put the cost of unnecessary services in the United States alone at more than 200 billion dollars a year

10.why: A段。a financial estimate ↔ One widely cited estimate put the cost … at more than 200 billion dollars；care that brings no benefit ↔ unnecessary services。B段的 inexpensive 只是在说甲状腺扫描便宜，不是费用估算。

ev.q: the rate at which thyroid cancer was diagnosed was around fifteen times higher than it had been in 1993, yet the number of people dying of the disease scarcely changed

11.why: B段。a sharp rise in diagnoses ↔ around fifteen times higher；without a fall in deaths ↔ the number of people dying … scarcely changed。F 是E段宫颈癌筛查的结果，不是韩国的甲状腺筛查。

ev.q: the decisive factor is a payment system that rewards hospitals and clinics for the number of procedures they carry out

12.why: C段。the way hospitals are paid ↔ a payment system that rewards hospitals and clinics；encourages excessive treatment ↔ rewards … for the number of procedures。D 是陷阱：病人期待开药是C段的泛泛描述，不是 Okoye 的研究发现。

ev.q: Lists of this kind, he maintains, rarely alter behaviour unless the financial incentives that encourage unnecessary care are changed at the same time.

13.why: D段。guidance alone achieves little ↔ Lists of this kind … rarely alter behaviour；unless money is also involved ↔ unless the financial incentives … are changed。A 是 medical societies 做的事，不是 Eriksen。

ev.q: those given decision aids, short guides that set out the options and their probable outcomes, chose an operation less often

14.why: F段。well-informed patients ↔ those given decision aids, short guides that set out the options；opted for surgery less often ↔ chose an operation less often。
